from datetime import datetime, timedelta

access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZSthbmdlbGljYS53aWxzQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.6ySJXKnhKUO9K2PbEd9u1h9v7lsCC75Oztrh7oP3njI'

# Using previously found habit-tracker note list by re-fetching titles/IDs to be safe
all_notes=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query='', tags=['habit-tracker'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not isinstance(resp,list) or len(resp)==0:
        break
    all_notes.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

# Parse date from title
items=[]
for n in all_notes:
    title=n.get('title','')
    # expected format: Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD
    date_str=None
    if '--' in title:
        parts=title.split('--')
        if len(parts)>=2:
            date_str=parts[1].strip()
    if date_str is None:
        continue
    try:
        d=datetime.strptime(date_str,'%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except Exception as e:
        continue
    items.append({'note_id': n.get('note_id'), 'date': d, 'title': title})

# Fetch each note content to see ate_homemade_meals
ate_by_date={}
for it in sorted(items, key=lambda x:x['date']):
    note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=it['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content=note.get('content','')
    ate_val=None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            ate_val=line.split(':',1)[1].strip().lower()
            break
    ate_by_date[it['date']]= (ate_val=='yes')

# Print coverage
dates_sorted=sorted(ate_by_date.keys())
print('min_date', dates_sorted[0], 'max_date', dates_sorted[-1], 'count', len(dates_sorted))
# Verify consecutive
missing=[]
for i in range((dates_sorted[-1]-dates_sorted[0]).days+1):
    dd=dates_sorted[0]+timedelta(days=i)
    if dd not in ate_by_date:
        missing.append(dd)
print('missing_days', missing)

# Compute longest consecutive True streak
best_len=0
best_start=None
best_end=None
cur_len=0
cur_start=None
prev_date=None
for dd in sorted(ate_by_date.keys()):
    if ate_by_date[dd]:
        if cur_len==0:
            cur_start=dd
            cur_len=1
        else:
            # streak continues only if dates are consecutive
            if prev_date is not None and (dd-prev_date).days==1:
                cur_len+=1
            else:
                cur_start=dd
                cur_len=1
        if cur_len>best_len:
            best_len=cur_len
            best_start=cur_start
            best_end=dd
    else:
        cur_len=0
        cur_start=None
    prev_date=dd

print('best_streak_len', best_len, 'start', best_start, 'end', best_end)

# Print a small table around the best streak
if best_start is not None:
    table=[]
    dd=best_start
    while dd<=best_end:
        table.append((dd.isoformat(), 'yes' if ate_by_date[dd] else 'no'))
        dd=dd+timedelta(days=1)
    print('best_table', table)

# Also print full list for quick sanity
full=[(d.isoformat(), 'yes' if ate_by_date[d] else 'no') for d in sorted(ate_by_date.keys())]
print('full:', full)
